title: Everestdan 2,5 baravar baland tog' qayerda joylashgan?

scenes.text: Bu tog'ning balandligi taxminan 22 kilometr, Everestdan 2,5 baravar baland.
Lekin u Yerda emas. Bu Marsdagi Olimp tog'i, ulkan vulqon.
1971 yilda Marsga yetib borgan Mariner 9 zondi uni yaqindan suratga oldi.
Bu Quyosh tizimidagi eng baland tog'lardan biri.

description:
Marsdagi Olimp tog'i (Olympus Mons) taxminan 21,9 km balandlikda, bu Everestning dengiz sathidan balandligidan taxminan 2,5 baravar ko'p. Etagining eni taxminan 600 km. Uni 1971-1972 yillarda Mariner 9 zondi yaqindan suratga olgan.

Siz buni bilarmidingiz? Izohda "ha" yoki "yo'q" deb yozing.
source: Wikipedia: Olympus Mons (about 21.9 km above the Mars datum, about 2.5 times Everest's height above sea level, about 600 km wide; mapped by Mariner 9 in 1971-72) https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Olympus_Mons ; NASA Science: Mars facts.
